questions.stem_text: Describe the function of the lateral-line system in fishes.

options.A: The lateral-line system in fishes helps with the digestion of food.
options.B: The lateral-line system in fishes is used for excreting waste materials.
options.C: The lateral-line system in fishes is involved in the secretion of hormones.
options.D: The lateral-line system in fishes is used for breathing.
options.E: The lateral-line system in fishes is used for vision.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The lateral-line system in fishes helps with the digestion of food.

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements about trypsin is NOT true?

options.A: It is an organic compound made of proteins.
options.B: It is a catalyst that alters the rate of a reaction.
options.C: It is operative over a wide pH range.
options.D: The rate of catalysis is affected by the concentration of substrate.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - It is operative over a wide pH range.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following adaptive features would least likely be found in an animal living
in a hot arid environment?

options.A: High metabolic rate to generate heat
options.B: Storage of water in fatty tissues
options.C: Long loops of Henle to maximize water reabsorption
options.D: Short loops of Henle to maximize water secretion
options.E: Large amounts of body hair to trap heat

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Short loops of Henle to maximize water secretion

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements about lipids is correct?

options.A: Lipids are the primary source of energy for cellular processes.
options.B: Lipids are soluble in water but insoluble in organic solvents.
options.D: Steroids are lipids that consist of glycerol and fatty acids.
options.E: Lipids make up most cell surface receptors.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Phospholipids are water soluble.

questions.stem_text: Why does milk \textquotedblleftspoil\textquotedblright when kept in a refrigerator?

options.A: Milk spoils due to high temperatures
options.B: Milk spoils exclusively due to the separation of fat content at lower temperatures
options.C: Milk spoils because of thermophilic bacteria
options.D: Psychrophilic bacteria cause milk to spoil in cool temperatures.
options.E: Milk spoils as a result of exposure to light inside the refrigerator

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Psychrophilic bacteria cause milk to spoil in cool temperatures.
